newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Brambles sees lower dividend franking.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Brambles sees lower dividend franking.

text.p: Brambles Industries Ltd said on Thursday that it would have to reduce the level of dividend franking in 1996/97 but repeated its forecast that it should achieve higher profits this year.

"Unfortunately, the expected growth in overseas earnings means that the companywill need to reduce the level of franking dividends for 1996/97," chief executive John Fletcher said in the company's annual report.
"While this is regrettable for Australian shareholders, it is a measure of our success in building an international business," Fletcher said.
The transport company paid a fully franked dividend of 69.0 cents in 1995/96, based on a hike in net earnings to A$215.1 million from A$97.66 million a year earlier.
Its profit rise was one of the standout features of the 1995/96 reporting season when many other bluechip companies revealed flat or lower results.
"Despite uncertainty in the direction of the Australian and European economies in particular, the company is confident of delivering further profit growth this year," Fletcher said.
